note: Hand-derived exact programs measured to complete levels via scripts/fap_program_premise.py against the strict-offline arcade, seed 0. Coordinates are x=column, y=row. sc25 requires one wake action first (the engine swallows the first post-reset action in that game only).

ft09.rule: Each 3x3 tile grid's centre glyph is a miniature of its own grid (glyph 2 <-> tile 9, glyph 0 <-> tile 8/marked colour = glyph centre colour). Click the tiles whose glyph cell is 0, in the grid(s) whose glyph mismatches its surround.

sc25.rule: Punch the die's pip pattern into the 3x3 board (0-cells mark pips; clicking a 2-cell costs a timer tick), then roll the shrunken track marker left (action 3) to the docking box.
sc25.level1_result: score 0->1; the win landed within the 13 rolls (trailing rolls harmless)
